modules.title: Introduction to Operating Systems
modules.html:
Functions and types of operating systems and file management. This section covers introduction to operating systems.

Key points

  • Which of the following is an example of an Operating System — Linux.
  • Which is an Operating System — Windows.
  • Which of these is NOT an operating system — Microsoft Word.
  • The term used for a person who gains unauthorized access to computer systems is a... — Hacker.

Worked examples

Q: Which of the following is an example of an Operating System?
A: Linux — Linux is a system software (Operating System) that manages computer hardware and software resources. The others are application softwares.

Q: Which is an Operating System?
A: Windows — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Windows.

quiz.q: Which of the following is an example of an Operating System?
quiz.solution: Linux is a system software (Operating System) that manages computer hardware and software resources. The others are application softwares.

quiz.q: Which is an Operating System?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Windows.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT an operating system?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Microsoft Word.

quiz.q: The term used for a person who gains unauthorized access to computer systems is a...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Hacker.

quiz.q: In Microsoft Excel, the intersection of a row and a column is called a _____.
quiz.solution: A cell is the basic unit of a spreadsheet where data is entered, identified by a column letter and row number (e.g., A1).

quiz.q: Which of the following is an input device?
quiz.solution: A scanner is an input device that captures images from photographic prints, posters, and similar sources for computer editing.

quiz.q: A pre-defined formula in Excel is known as a _____.
quiz.solution: Functions (like SUM, AVERAGE) are built-in formulas in Excel that perform specific calculations.

quiz.q: The file extension for a PowerPoint presentation is usually _____.
quiz.solution: .pptx is the standard file extension for Microsoft PowerPoint presentations created in versions 2007 and later.

quiz.q: Which utility is used to reduce the size of files to save disk space?
quiz.solution: File compression (like ZIP) reduces the file size by encoding data more efficiently.

quiz.q: 1 Byte is equal to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 8 bits.

quiz.q: ROM is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Non-volatile.

quiz.q: Booting is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Starting the computer.

quiz.q: Recycle Bin stores:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Deleted files.

quiz.q: CPU stands for:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Central Processing Unit.

quiz.q: What does ISP stand for?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Internet Service Provider.

quiz.q: The blinking line on the screen is called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Cursor.

quiz.q: Software types:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: System and Application.

quiz.q: Short cut for Paste:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ctrl+V.

quiz.q: Flowchart is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Diagrammatic representation.

quiz.q: A byte consists of how many bits?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: 8 bits.

quiz.q: The illegal copying and distribution of software is called...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Software Piracy.

quiz.q: The protocol used for browsing the web is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: HTTP.

quiz.q: Which component performs calculations?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: ALU.

quiz.q: Input Device:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Scanner.

quiz.q: Virus:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Malicious Program.

quiz.q: Octal:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Base 8.

quiz.q: Cold Boot:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Power on.

quiz.q: Spreadsheet Col:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Letters.

quiz.q: Decision symbol in flowchart:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Diamond.
